items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: He and Sam Dutre and Dennis Gishard and Cyril August and.

ctx.x: No, my brother played with Robichaux. He played with him for a long time. Well you see at the time he was playing with Robichaux, oh I think I had left Desvene because I played with Desvene a year, not quite a year. And I came to Chicago and stayed in Chicago. But all during that time he was playing with Robichaux at the time. He and Sam Dutre and Dennis Gishard and Cyril August and.
Sam Dutre, that's the younger Sam Dutre I guess. His father was an old time.
